title: Puzzling Through Travel Retail’s Dilemmas
summary: The once-soaring channel is grappling with how best to handle a new reality: Foot traffic is up, but spend is down.

extraction.key_fact: 트래블 리테일 채널은 방문객 수는 증가했으나 지출은 감소하는 새로운 현실에 직면해 있다.
